text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*... What should I do about the 
speech for the party? I have to figure out 
a plan somehow...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Being from the Mejiro family, you must 
face many such occasions... I'm not good 
at public speaking either, so I understand 
how you feel.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Really? You spoke so passionately about 
books that I assumed you were good at it.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Th-That was just in the heat of the 
moment, I got carried away...! ...So 
giving a speech or anything is just, um...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Actually, I thought you were the one 
good at public speaking, Dober-san. To me, 
you always look so dignified...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's not true. My mind goes completely 
blank pretty quickly, and—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
M-Me too...! And then when I try my 
hardest to make up for it, it ends up not 
coming across right—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
They get super down in the dumps 
afterwards, you know...! They get crazy 
down in the dumps afterwards, you know...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Heh... Ahaha! Oh, I see. You too, Rob Roy?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... So that's how it was for you too, 
Dober-san...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Um, if it's all right with you, would 
you like to look for a how-to book on 
public speaking together...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that helps a lot. With you around, 
Rob Roy, I know we'll definitely find some 
great books.
